from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class BMP280_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_WIDTH = 16  # 本基准目标器件寄存器宽度（16 位为主）

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Initialize all registers to their reset values
        self.regs = {
            0xD0: 0x58,  # id
            0xE0: 0x00,  # reset
            0xF3: 0x00,  # status
            0xF4: 0x00,  # ctrl_meas
            0xF5: 0x00,  # config
            0xF7: 0x80,  # press_msb
            0xF8: 0x00,  # press_lsb
            0xF9: 0x00,  # press_xlsb
            0xFA: 0x80,  # temp_msb
            0xFB: 0x00,  # temp_lsb
            0xFC: 0x00   # temp_xlsb
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if addr in self.regs:
            return self.regs[addr]
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Register address {addr} not found")

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr in self.regs:
            if addr == 0xE0:  # reset
                if data == 0xB6:
                    # Soft reset
                    self.regs[0xF3] = 0x00  # status
                    self.regs[0xF4] = 0x00  # ctrl_meas
                    self.regs[0xF5] = 0x00  # config
                    self.regs[0xF7] = 0x80  # press_msb
                    self.regs[0xF8] = 0x00  # press_lsb
                    self.regs[0xF9] = 0x00  # press_xlsb
                    self.regs[0xFA] = 0x80  # temp_msb
                    self.regs[0xFB] = 0x00  # temp_lsb
                    self.regs[0xFC] = 0x00   # temp_xlsb
                else:
                    # Write other values than 0xB6 has no effect
                    pass
            else:
                # Ignore writes to RO registers
                pass
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Register address {addr} not found")
